title: Beyond-Birthday-Bound MAC Under Multicollision Nonce Misuse
summary: To the authors' knowledge, existing and explored candidates fail to achieve beyond-birthday-bound security under multicollision nonce misuse; whether a nonce-based MAC meeting the stated efficiency target exists remains open.

formal_statement.body: Does there exist a nonce-based MAC using at most two block-cipher calls and one hash call that is BBB-secure under multicollision nonce misuse, even for multicollisions of size $2$?

scope.domain: Nonce-based MAC design using block ciphers and hash functions under multicollision nonce misuse.
parameters: At most two block-cipher calls: efficiency budget
Nonce multicollisions of size 2: target misuse level
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether a nonce-based MAC within the stated call limits can achieve BBB security under multicollision nonce misuse, including multicollisions of size 2.

citations.label: Beyond Birthday Bound Secure MAC in Faulty Nonce Model

progress.summary: The source presents an explicit existence question and reports, to the authors' knowledge, that existing MACs and explored variants fail to achieve beyond-birthday-bound security under multicollision nonce misuse, even at size 2.
citation_labels: Avijit Dutta et al., Beyond Birthday Bound Secure MAC in Faulty Nonce Model
